name: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd
title: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd - 544122 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Entero is a pharma and MedTech distributor guiding FY27 revenue +23% (about 11% from calendarisation) and 5% EBITDA margin, with margin expansion driven by gross margin and commercial-role MedTech contracts rather than capacity.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue +23%, EBITDA 5%
triggers.quote: We aim for consolidated revenue growth of 23% year-on-year, excluding any new acquisitions with 5% EBITDA margins.

triggers.label: Gross margin 10.9% in Q4, +110bps
triggers.quote: Gross margin expanded by 110 basis points to 10.9% during the quarter

triggers.label: Minority interest ~38% of Q4 PAT
triggers.quote: This quarter, the minority interest was almost 38% of our PAT.

guidance.quote: We aim for consolidated revenue growth of 23% year-on-year, excluding any new acquisitions with 5% EBITDA margins.
We aim for consolidated revenue growth of 23% year-on-year, excluding any new acquisitions with 5% EBITDA margins.

guidance.metric: EBITDA to operating cash flow conversion
guidance.quote: We aim to deliver EBITDA to operating cash flow conversion ratio to be at least 50% to ensure sustainable growth path for future.
we expect it to be in the range of about 22% - 23% for FY '27.

prior_guidance_check.quote: our full year revenue on a like-for-like basis grew by 31.5% with top line at INR6,591 crores.
I'm pleased to share that we delivered 4% EBITDA margin
operating cash flow of INR96.2 crores for the full year.

red_flags.label: Minority interest ~38% of Q4 PAT, guided ~25-27% FY27
red_flags.quote: This quarter, the minority interest was almost 38% of our PAT.

red_flags.label: Net worth flat due to put option liability
red_flags.quote: This is basically the impact of the first -time recognition of put option liability.

red_flags.label: Q4 IPM outperformance fell to ~1.4x
red_flags.quote: And 1.4x is again the outperformance in Q4 as well.

evasions.quote: Why don't we -- our finance team will give you a range.
Every FY '28 guidance I'm not giving.

evasions.quote: I will share with you separately.
